# Psych Central

> > Psych Central provides evidence-based mental health information, treatment guides, and educational content covering bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, anxiety, depression, and other mental health conditions.

The site features expert-reviewed articles on symptom management, medication options like mood stabilizers, and various psychotherapy approaches including CBT and FFT. Psych Central also produces mental health podcasts including Inside Bipolar and Inside Mental Health, featuring hosts Gabe Howard, Dr. Nicole Washington, and Rachel Star Withers discussing lived experiences and breaking down mental health stigma.

## Key Topics

- Bipolar disorder
- Schizophrenia
- Mood stabilizers and medication management
- Mental health stigma and advocacy
- Symptom management
- Psychotherapy (CBT, FFT)
- Mood episodes and hypomania
- Treatment options
- Lived experience perspectives
- Depression and anxiety
- Peer support
- Electroconvulsive therapy (ECT)
- Medication adherence
- Women's mental health
- Mental health podcasts

## Bipolar Disorder Resources

- [Mood Stabilizers List: Uses, Types, and Side Effects](https://psychcentral.com/health/mood-stabilizers-list): Comprehensive guide to mood stabilizers like lithium for bipolar disorder
- [Can Bipolar Disorder Be Cured?](https://psychcentral.com/bipolar/can-bipolar-be-cured): Explores bipolar treatment options including CBT, FFT, and therapy approaches
- [Podcast: ECT: Medical Torture or Effective Treatment?](https://psychcentral.com/blog/inside-bipolar-podcast-ect-medical-torture-or-effective-treatment-electroconvulsive-therapy): Examines electroconvulsive therapy myths and realities for bipolar disorder
- [Bipolar Podcast: The Impact of Menstrual Cycles and Hormonal Flux](https://psychcentral.com/blog/inside-bipolar-podcast-the-impact-of-menstrual-cycles-and-hormonal-fluctuations): Dr. Washington & Natasha Tracy on hormonal impacts on bipolar management
- [Podcast: Is Hypomania Controllable? Myths, Realities, and Risks](https://psychcentral.com/blog/inside-bipolar-podcast-is-hypomania-controllable-myths-realities-and-risks): Gabe Howard & Dr. Washington explore hypomania control myths and realities
- [Podcast: The Truth About Resilience with Bipolar Disorder](https://psychcentral.com/blog/inside-bipolar-podcast-the-truth-about-resilience): Howard & Dr. Washington tackle resilience buzzword in bipolar disorder context
- [Podcast: Beyond Spa Days: Self-Care and the 8 Dimensions of Wellness](https://psychcentral.com/blog/inside-bipolar-podcast-beyond-spa-days-self-care-and-the-8-dimensions-of-wellness): Explores 8 Dimensions of Wellness beyond self-care clichés for bipolar

## Schizophrenia Education

- [Podcast: Schizophrenia Unmasked: Facts, Myths, and Lived Reality](https://psychcentral.com/blog/podcast-schizophrenia-unmasked-facts-myths-and-lived-reality): Rachel Star Withers & Dr. Cobia discuss schizophrenia science and experience
- [Podcast: Medication & Schizophrenia: Why 'Just Be Med Compliant' Fails](https://psychcentral.com/blog/podcast-medication-schizophrenia-why-just-be-med-compliant-fails): Dr. Augsten & Rachel Withers on medication adherence challenges in schizophrenia

## Anxiety and Depression Support

- [EFT Tapping: How to Relieve Anxiety in 5 Steps](https://psychcentral.com/health/eft-tapping): 5-step guide to Emotional Freedom Technique tapping for anxiety relief
- [How to Find a Cigna-Covered Therapist for Anxiety in Texas](https://psychcentral.com/anxiety/cigna-therapist-for-anxiety-texas): Guide to finding Cigna-covered anxiety therapists in Texas using Octave
- [Podcast: Dating with Depression (or Another Mental Health Issue)](https://psychcentral.com/blog/podcast-dating-with-depression-or-another-mental-health-issue): Kati Morton discusses dating challenges with depression and mental illness

## Mental Health Stigma and Advocacy

- [Podcast: Breaking Stigma in Women's Mental Health with Kit Wallis](https://psychcentral.com/blog/inside-bipolar-podcast-breaking-stigma-in-womens-mental-health-with-kit-wallis): Kit Wallis discusses women's mental health stigma on Inside Bipolar podcast
- [Podcast: Hollywood Often Gets OCD Wrong: Actor & Director Speak Out](https://psychcentral.com/blog/podcast-hollywood-often-gets-ocd-wrong-actor-director-speak-out): Rachel Alig & Sam Sabawi on OCD misrepresentation in Hollywood media
- [Podcast: Happier Made Simple with Randye Kaye](https://psychcentral.com/blog/podcast-happier-made-simple-with-randye-kaye): Randye Kaye discusses achieving 'happier' vs 'happy' in mental health journey

## Additional Mental Health Topics

- [Retrograde Amnesia: Definition, Symptoms, and Treatment](https://psychcentral.com/health/retrograde-amnesia): Covers retrograde amnesia symptoms, Ribot's law, and treatment options
- [What is Collaborative Divorce?](https://psychcentral.com/relationships/collaborative-divorce): Explains collaborative divorce as alternative to traditional legal process
